sections.h2: Pilgrimage, not holiday, leads overnight trips: 48% against 22%

chart.title: Pilgrimage and health trips outnumber holiday trips in the 365-day group
chart.sub: Share of overnight trips in the 365-day group, by main purpose, %.
chart.source: MoSPI press note, 23 Sep 2026, as reported.

sections.means: The survey shows that most overnight trips in the 365-day group are for pilgrimage or treatment, not holidays.
sections.todo: Read these shares with the 365-day reference period in mind, since the 30-day group is not comparable.

sections.h2: Health trips cost rural households ₹29,454 each, against ₹5,179 for business trips

chart.title: A rural health trip costs far more than a 30-day business trip
chart.sub: Average spending per overnight trip, rural households, ₹.
chart.source: MoSPI press note via BusinessToday and The Tribune, as reported.

sections.means: Health trips are the costliest overnight trips per household, which the survey's spending figures show for both rural and urban households.
sections.todo: Ask the Tourism Ministry to publish spending by trip purpose so that health travel can be costed in its schemes.

sections.h2: Uttar Pradesh is 15.7% of survey trips but 36.3% of ministry visits in 2025

chart.title: Uttar Pradesh's share differs sharply between the survey and the ministry count
chart.sub: Uttar Pradesh share, %, by source and year.
chart.source: Household survey 2025-26 and Tourism Ministry, as reported in press coverage.

sections.means: The state's share of visits in the ministry count is far above its share of household trips in the survey, though the two sources use different bases.
sections.todo: Publish the survey and ministry state counts side by side, with their bases stated, so readers can compare them.
